title: Thistle Junction
description: A generous triple dance alternates with a shorter five-eighth answer. Its returns contract from eight to six to four bars, while the asymmetric answers grow from six to eight. A continuous four-beat song becomes the centre of gravity. The closing eleven-eighth bars join the three quarter steps and the answer’s long-short-long gesture through their unchanged eighth-note subdivision.
technical_note: Keep the same eighth-note subdivision through every change of metre. Let the five-eighth answer lean on its written long-short-long shape without an added swing setting. In the closing bars hear the three quarters followed by the complete five-eighth gesture, allowing their shared phrase to settle without slowing the final rest.

performance.note: Authored phrase breathing and melodic voicing; independent rhythm is written in the score, with a shared tempo map.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
